## Rulings

- [decision-0001-ruling-01](../records/decision-0001.md#decision-0001-ruling-01): An accepted record changes only through a new record that supersedes it.
- [decision-0001-ruling-02](../records/decision-0001.md#decision-0001-ruling-02): Every ruling carries a stable identifier derived from its record identifier.
- [decision-0002-ruling-01](../records/decision-0002.md#decision-0002-ruling-01): Record identifiers are `decision-` followed by a zero-padded sequence number.
- [decision-0004-ruling-01](../records/decision-0004.md#decision-0004-ruling-01): A record receives its sequence number when it is merged, never when it is drafted.
- [decision-0004-ruling-02](../records/decision-0004.md#decision-0004-ruling-02): Drafts use a provisional `decision-xxxx` identifier that the merge replaces.
